meta.title: 生病时怀疑人生，才想通陪伴的意义
meta.title_en: Illness Made Me Doubt My Life — Then I Learned What Matters

scenes.title_en: Doubting that I got my whole life wrong
scenes.context: 讲者回忆生病时对前半生的自我怀疑，并指出怀疑来自虚弱。
sentences: 在生病的时候，一段时间我怀疑过自己，是不是前半生真的都做错了？
During my illness, there was a stretch when I doubted myself — had I gotten my whole first half of life wrong?
前半生：the first half of my life
我过去的几十年的努力辛苦，是不是全都做错了、白费了？
Were all those decades of effort and hardship just wasted?
白费了：all wasted
因为我太虚弱了，会带来头脑的不坚定。
Because I was so weak, my mind was unsteady.
头脑不坚定：an unsteady mind
paraphrase: 生病时的自我否定→是虚弱投射
Self-doubt in illness is projected by weakness.
头脑不坚定→判断不可靠
An unsteady mind makes your judgment unreliable.
scenes.speak: During my illness, there was a stretch when I doubted myself — had I gotten my whole first half of life wrong? Were all those decades of effort and hardship just wasted? Because I was so weak, my mind was unsteady.

scenes.title_cn: 有孩子就全解决？太简单了
scenes.title_en: Would a child solve everything? Too simple
scenes.context: 讲者想明白：如果有个孩子就一切问题都解决，那世界也太简单了。
sentences: 我当时生一个娃，那我就成功了，我真的怀疑过。
Back then I even thought: if I'd had a kid, I'd have succeeded. I really did doubt it.
生一个娃：had a kid
后来是彻底想明白。
Later, I finally saw it clearly.
彻底想明白：finally see it clearly
如果说我有一个孩子就什么问题都解决了，那这世界上也太简单了，很多问题就不存在了。
If having a child solved everything, the world would be far too simple — those problems wouldn't even exist.
什么问题都解决：solve everything
paraphrase: 把困境归因于身份→是简化叙事
Blame a missing identity? That's oversimplified storytelling.
想明白→问题的结构更复杂
The real structure of problems is more complex.
scenes.speak: Back then I even thought: if I'd had a kid, I'd have succeeded. I really did doubt it. Later, I finally saw it clearly. If having a child solved everything, the world would be far too simple — those problems wouldn't even exist.

scenes.title_en: What matters is someone who stays with you
scenes.context: 讲者指出重要的感情是能相见、能相望于江湖、能天天陪着你的人，不管他是谁。
sentences: 那什么样的感情重要？那就是既能相见，又能相望于江湖的。
So what kind of bond matters? One that lets you meet and also lets you drift apart gracefully.
相忘于江湖：drift apart gracefully
然后他能够天天陪你的。
And it's someone who can be with you every single day.
天天陪你：with you every single day
你管他是不是你的儿子、是不是你的女儿、是不是你的谁。
Whether they're your son, your daughter, or whoever — it doesn't matter.
你管他是谁：it doesn't matter who they are
paraphrase: 重要的不是称呼→是在场
It's not the title that matters; it's presence.
能相见也能相忘→健康的关系边界
Meeting freely and parting gently — that's a healthy bond.
scenes.speak: So what kind of bond matters? One that lets you meet and also lets you drift apart gracefully. And it's someone who can be with you every single day. Whether they're your son, your daughter, or whoever — it doesn't matter.

practice: During illness, I doubted whether I'd gotten my life wrong.
Later, I finally saw it clearly.
What matters is someone who's with you every single day.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I doubted whether the first half of my life was all wrong.
✓ 地道说法：I doubted whether I'd gotten my whole first half of life wrong.
got my life wrong 更口语。
✕ 直译腔：The world is too simple if a child solves all problems.
✓ 地道说法：If having a child solved everything, the world would be far too simple.
用 if...would be 的虚拟句式更自然。
✕ 直译腔：Look at each other in the rivers and lakes.
✓ 地道说法：Let each other drift apart gracefully.
drift apart gracefully 表达「相忘于江湖」之意。
✕ 直译腔：You don't care if he is your son or your daughter.
✓ 地道说法：Son, daughter, or whoever — it doesn't matter.
it doesn't matter 更简洁地道。
